title: QuasiCoherentSymmetricAlgebraAffine
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and $S=P^\#$ the explicitly constructed symmetric algebra sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]. Then the underlying $\mathcal O_X$-module of $S$ is quasi-coherent, and for every affine open $U$, the sheafification unit $\theta_U: \operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_X(U)}F(U)\to S(U)$ is bijective.

source.place: Modules, Section 01CF (section-symmetric-exterior, line 3262: definition of Sym(F) as a quotient of the tensor algebra), Lemma 01CG (lemma-local-tensor-algebra, line 3303: Sym^n F is the sheafification of U -> Sym^n_{O(U)}(F(U))), Lemma 01CL (lemma-whole-tensor-algebra-permanence, line 3461: Sym of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent); Schemes, Section 01LA item (9) (schemes.tex line 4717); used as Sym^*_{O_X} in Properties, Lemmas 05JS, 086N, 0817

proof.text: Construct the explicit chart comparison alpha_W by the affine tilde adjunction, and use its global-section factorization. This is the construction and identity of def-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-affine-comparison-map.

For quasi-coherent F the comparison is bijective on every abelian stalk by lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-affine-comparison-stalks. Mathlib app_bijective_of_stalkFunctor_map_bijective makes all its section maps bijective. Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app then makes alpha_W an isomorphism of modules.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CH and conservativity of module stalks

proof.text: The tilde of A has a global presentation presentationTilde. Transport it through alpha_W using Presentation.ofIsIso. The charts Spec O_X(W) for all affine opens W cover X. The proved isQuasicoherent_of_iSup_opensRange_eq_top glues these presentations, so the underlying module of S is quasi-coherent. This is descent of local presentations, the definition of quasi-coherence.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CL (lemma-whole-tensor-algebra-permanence); quasi-coherence by local presentations

proof.text: For any affine W, compose the bijective tilde.toOpen A top with the bijective section component alpha_top and the existing upstream sectionsTopRestrictFromSpecEquiv linear chart section equivalence. affineComparison_top identifies this composite pointwise with theta_W. Function.Bijective.comp and function extensionality prove bijectivity of the unchanged sectionMap.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Lemmas 01CG, 01CH and 01CL; Schemes, Lemmas 01I7 and 01I8. The affine chart comparison and its factorization are constructed in Lean. Step 6 is isolated as a stalkwise bijectivity theorem; stalk conservativity, descent of tilde presentations and composition of affine section bijections are proved in Lean.
